decision.observation: Clicking DENIED triggered a red stamp press, but the impression appears on the rail at x≈0.64 while the visa box (dashed, empty) is at x≈0.70–0.82 — horizontally offset, so the stamp didn't land in the visa.
decision.hypothesis: Dragging the passport left so the visa rectangle centers exactly under the red stamp, then pressing DENIED, stamps the visa correctly.
decision.memory: Stamp presses at the stamp's own x-position; visa must be horizontally centered beneath it.
